text: Per diem reminder: tier 1 cap is meals only. The hotel goes against the lodging line, not the per diem. We had three resubmissions last month.
Q1 expense reports older than 90 days will not be reimbursed without a Treasury exception. Get them in.
Frequent flyer status push: if you're close to a status bump, the year end window is shorter this year. Plan trips accordingly.
If your phone GPS isn't picking up your hotel in Concur, switch to manual address entry. The map provider hit a temporary glitch.
Corporate card transactions older than 7 days that aren't coded will be auto flagged to the manager. Code them.
